extensionDescription.message: Extract and translate text from images or any selected area of a web page using local OCR.

providerLlm.description: Translation provider using a large language model (LLM).

commonUnknown.description: Shown when the source text's language could not be detected.

commonAuto.description: Automatically detect the language of the text to recognize.

commonCurrentValue.description: $1 is the currently saved language code, absent from the available choices.

commonSoftwareOnly.description: WebGPU is available through software, without hardware acceleration.

commonConnected.description: The connection test to the LLM server succeeded.

commonNoTextDetected.message: No text was detected. Please check if the source language is set correctly or select "Auto".

statusLoadingImage.description: Progress message while loading the captured or selected image.

statusInitializingOcr.description: Progress message while preparing the text recognition engine.

optionsTranslationSectionTitle.description: Heading for the translation settings section

optionsTargetLanguage.description: Label for the target language selector

optionsTranslationProvider.description: Label for the translation provider selector

optionsGoogleProviderHint.message: No API key is required. Rate limits may apply.

optionsLlmEndpoint.description: Settings for the server API used for LLM translation.

optionsLlmEndpointHint.message: Any server with an OpenAI-compatible API, such as llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, OpenRouter, etc.

optionsRemoveOriginHeader.description: Origin is the HTTP request header name; keep it unchanged.

optionsRemoveOriginHeaderHint.message: For Ollama only. Removes the Origin request header to prevent HTTP 403 Forbidden errors when requests are sent from the extension.

optionsEndpointUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API used for translation.

optionsModel.description: Language model used for translation, not the OCR model.

optionsFetchModels.description: Button that retrieves the server's list of model names; it does not download models.

optionsModelNotFound.description: $1 is the saved model name, missing from the server's model list.

optionsRequestTimeout.description: Maximum time to wait for a translation request.

optionsDisableModelThinking.description: Disable the model's extra reasoning step before it answers.

optionsDisableModelThinkingHint.message: Faster answers from reasoning models. Works with vLLM, llama.cpp and Ollama. WARNING: this setting is not supported by api.openai.com/v1 endpoint.

optionsOpenSourceNote.message: Screen OCR Translator is open-source software licensed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0.

optionsDefaultSourceLanguage.description: Language of the text in the image, used for OCR.

optionsDefaultSourceLanguageHint.message: Select the language of the original text, or "Auto" to automatically detect the language (text recognition may take a little longer).

optionsGpuHint.message: Runs text recognition on WebGPU. Depending on your browser, OS, and hardware, this may make it faster or slower. Falls back to CPU if not available.

optionsStartOcrImmediatelyHint.message: Skip the adjustment step and start recognition as soon as you release the mouse.

optionsSee.description: Text before the optionsEnableWebGpuLink link: 'See how to enable WebGPU in your browser'.

optionsEnableWebGpuLink.message: how to enable WebGPU in your browser

optionsDisplaySectionTitle.description: Settings for how recognition and translation results appear.

optionsUiLanguageHint.message: Choose the language used by the extension.

optionsDisplayHint.message: Where the translated text appears after capture.

optionsDefaultOverlayMode.description: Whether a new overlay initially shows translated text or the original image.

optionsOverlayModeTranslation.description: Show translated text over the captured image.

optionsOverlayModeOriginal.description: Show the original captured image without translated text over it.

optionsDefaultOverlayModeHint.message: Choose the initial view for each new overlay

optionsFetchingModels.description: Progress message while retrieving the server's model list.

optionsModelsFound.description: $1 is the number of models returned by the server; used for counts greater than one.

optionsSaveFailed.description: $1 is the error detail explaining why settings could not be saved.

popupSourceLanguage.description: Language of the text in the image, used for OCR.

popupTargetLanguage.description: Language to translate the recognized text into.

popupDisplayModeOverlay.description: Display results over the selected area of the page.

popupDisplayModePanel.description: Display results in a panel in the bottom-right corner.

popupPickImage.description: Choose an image on the current web page to recognize and translate.

popupShortcutPrefix.description: Text before the keyboard shortcut: 'Press [shortcut] to select an area'.

popupShortcutSuffix.description: Text after the keyboard shortcut: 'Press [shortcut] to select an area'.

popupRestrictedPage.message: This browser page is restricted, so the extension can't access it. Try it on a regular web page.

popupReloadPage.message: Could not start. Please refresh the page and try again.

popupCouldNotStart.message: Screen OCR Translator could not start on this page.

popupLocalFilePermission.message: This extension needs permission to access local files. In add-on settings, select “Permissions and data” and enable “Access local files on your computer”, then reload this file.

popupCouldNotOpenShortcutSettings.message: Could not open keyboard shortcut settings.

selectionPressKeyToCancel.description: $1 is the keyboard key used to cancel selection.

selectionRunOcr.description: Button that starts text recognition and translation for the selected area.

languageTargetTitle.description: Language selector tooltip. $1 is the language to translate into.

languageSourceTitle.description: Language selector tooltip. $1 is the OCR source language or the automatic detection label.

panelShowInOverlay.description: Switch from result panel to overlay view.

panelDetectedLanguage.description: $1 is the detected source language name.

panelSourceLanguage.description: OCR language selector tooltip. $1 is the language name.

panelTranslationProvider.description: $1 is the translation provider's display name.

panelSourceText.description: Original text extracted from the image by OCR.

panelAlreadyInTargetLanguage.message: The text is already in the target language.

overlayAlreadyInTargetLanguage.message: The text is already in the target language

overlayHideTranslation.description: Show the original image in place of the translated text.

overlayCopyAllOriginal.description: Copy all recognized source text to the clipboard.

overlayCopyAllTranslated.description: Copy all translated text to the clipboard.

overlayReadAllOriginal.description: Read all recognized source text aloud using text-to-speech.

overlayReadAllTranslated.description: Read all translated text aloud using text-to-speech.

overlayCopyAllText.description: Copy all recognized text when no translation is available.

overlayReadAllText.description: Read all recognized text aloud when no translation is available.

overlayShowInPanel.description: Switch from results over the selected area to the floating result panel.

errorGoogleTranslateTimeout.message: Google Translate timed out after $1s. Try again, or switch to another translation provider.
errorGoogleTranslateTimeout.description: $1 is the timeout duration in seconds.

errorGoogleTranslateUnreachable.message: Couldn't reach Google Translate ($1). Check your internet connection, or switch to another translation provider.
errorGoogleTranslateUnreachable.description: $1 is the underlying connection error detail.

errorGoogleTranslateRequest.message: Google Translate request failed (HTTP $1). Try again later, or switch to another translation provider.

errorLlmEndpointNotConfigured.message: The LLM provider has no endpoint configured. Set the endpoint URL (e.g. http://localhost:8080/v1 for a local server) on the extension's settings page.

errorLlmFixEndpoint.message: $1 Fix the endpoint URL on the extension's settings page.
errorLlmFixEndpoint.description: $1 is the URL validation error message.

errorLlmInvalidTranslationFormat.message: The LLM returned an invalid translation format after a retry.

errorLlmTimeout.message: The LLM did not answer within $1s. The model may be slow — increase the request timeout and try again, or switch to another translation provider.
errorLlmTimeout.description: $1 is the timeout duration in seconds.

errorLlmUnreachable.message: Couldn't reach the LLM endpoint ($1). Please check your configuration and make sure the server is running.
errorLlmUnreachable.description: $1 is the underlying connection error detail.

errorLlmUnexpectedResponse.message: The LLM endpoint returned an unexpected response. Check that the URL points to an OpenAI-compatible API (usually ending in /v1).

errorLlmEmptyResponse.message: The LLM returned an empty response. Try again, or check the model name in settings.

errorEndpointUnreachable.description: $1 is the underlying connection error detail.

errorEndpointNoModelList.message: The endpoint didn't return a model list. Check that the URL points to an OpenAI-compatible API (usually ending in /v1).

errorLlmInvalidAbsoluteUrl.message: The LLM endpoint URL is not a valid absolute URL (e.g. http://localhost:8080/v1).

errorLlmHttpProtocol.message: The LLM endpoint URL must start with http:// or https://.

errorLlmNoQueryOrFragment.message: The LLM endpoint URL must not contain a query string or fragment.

errorCouldNotLoadImage.description: $1 is the underlying image loading error detail.

errorSelectionOutsideVisibleArea.message: Selection is outside the visible area.

errorCanvasContext.message: Could not create an image-processing canvas.

errorEncodeCapturedImage.message: Could not encode the captured image.

errorCapturedImageUnavailable.message: The captured image is no longer available. Please select the region again.

errorOcrWorkerCrashed.description: The background process running text recognition crashed.

errorOcrInsufficientMemory.message: OCR failed: Insufficient memory. Free up GPU memory or disable GPU acceleration in settings.

errorOcrHostStoppedResponding.description: The browser component hosting the OCR worker stopped responding.
